---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**What problem would it solve, or what's the use case?**
Why would this be useful — what are you trying to do when you run into this?

**Which module does this relate to?**
Tuner / Metronome / Key Finder / Chord Finder / Navigation / Other / Not sure

**Anything else?**
Mockups, examples from other apps, or other context are welcome but not required.
